description: User-confirmed NCTD COASTER: the prominent blue train in the daytime frame. Background vehicles are not labeled by this reference.
User-confirmed NCTD COASTER in a nighttime crop. Its colors look dark under nighttime lighting; do not mistake it for Surfliner simply because it is on the left.

User-confirmed Pacific Surfliner: the prominent train in this nighttime crop. The original full frame also had a distant MTS Trolley at the upper right; that background train is not the subject of this reference.
